aboutPage.title: Real cards, shipped from Erbil.
aboutPage.p1: KurdishTCG is an online shop for sealed trading card releases — booster packs and boxes from Riftbound, Naruto, Disney Lorcana, Avatar: The Last Airbender, SpongeBob and Zootopia.
aboutPage.p2: Every listing is photographed from the actual box, pack or card on our shelf, not a stock photo. New stock is sourced and shipped from Erbil to anywhere in Iraq.
aboutPage.p3: Pay cash on delivery, or instantly online with FIB. The site runs in English, Arabic and Kurdish (Sorani), so browse in whichever you're comfortable with.

contactPage.title: Get in touch
contactPage.body: Have a question about an order, a franchise we don't carry yet, or a bulk request? Reach us directly, or check out first — we call to confirm every cash order before it ships.
contactPage.comingSoon: We're finishing our direct contact line — check back soon, or place an order and we'll call to confirm it.

shippingPage.title: Delivery across Iraq
shippingPage.p1: We deliver to every governorate in Iraq. After you check out, we call the number on your order to confirm it before anything ships.
shippingPage.p2: Pay cash when it arrives, or settle instantly online with FIB at checkout.
shippingPage.p3: Sealed boxes and packs travel in protective packaging, so what you pull is what you saw in the listing.
shippingPage.note: Delivery windows vary by governorate — ask when we call to confirm your order.

returnsPage.title: Returns & refunds
returnsPage.p1: Wrong item, or damaged on arrival? Contact us as soon as you notice and we'll replace it or refund you — no questions asked.
returnsPage.p2: Sealed, unopened product can be returned if you've simply changed your mind; opened packs and boxes can't, since we can't verify what shipped once the seal is broken.
returnsPage.p3: Orders paid with FIB are refunded straight to your FIB account, within FIB's own 24-hour window on payments. Cash-on-delivery refunds are arranged directly when we speak.
returnsPage.note: Exact return windows are being finalized — contact us and we'll sort it out case by case.

faqPage.a1: Cash when your order arrives, or instantly online with FIB at checkout.
